description: Source code for generating API JSON documentation from parsed API data, including serialization functions for documentation classes and types.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the documentation object into a JSON-compatible structure.

methods.name: serializeClass
methods.description: Serializes a documentation class object into a plain object with selected properties.

methods.name: serializeMember
methods.description: Serializes a member of a class, including its arguments and type.

methods.name: serializeProperty
methods.description: Serializes a property or argument, including its type.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Removes internal or unnecessary properties from objects.

methods.name: serializeType
methods.description: Serializes a type object, including properties, union types, templates, arguments, and return types.
